content.title: The Deep Caverns
content.body:
Prepare to delve into the greater depths of the overworld!
    §lDon't Get Lost!
      - Equip yourself with:
      §l1. §rAntique Atlas
      §l2. §rCompass
    §lNavigation:
      - Bring:
      §l1. §rTorches
      §l2. §rSpare Blocks and Pickaxes
      §l3. §rWater Bucket
      §l4. §rExtensive knowledge of wall-jumping/sliding (crouch near a wall while in the air)
    §lOverword Changes:
      - New entities will spawn at night, having a chance of dropping more ectoplasm for you to make the next tier of armor.
    §lArmor:
      - Tremor: Iron
      - Furor: Heavy Iron
      - Devout: Weta (Chitin is dropped by Wetas, or found in Intestines)
      - Arcum: Brass (Alloy of Copper and Zinc dusts)
    §lTip:
      - focus on improving survivability instead of damage in this phase
